decisionMeaning: This manifest records what the product is *permitted* to advertise and what has actually been accepted on a real host. It is not a claim that any row has passed. Every row carries `acceptanceEvidence`; a row whose evidence is empty is an open sales gate, and deploy/native/run-support-matrix.mjs fails closed on it.

rows.tamperResistance: host-mediated-hook; a disabled or crashed hook is fail-closed by the connector, not by the host
knownBypasses: Running the model against a file or shell channel the harness does not route through PreToolUse
Direct network access that never constructs a tool call
unobservedActions: Same-turn model blocking on a real Claude host
Behaviour when the host vendor ships a new hook schema

rows.tamperResistance: extension-host API boundary; the extension hook always exits 0 with a deny verdict so a killed hook cannot pass a call through
installPath: .vsix install via MDM or the extension gallery
knownBypasses: Tools executed outside the extension host (an external terminal)
unobservedActions: Headless agent enforcement coverage on a real Cursor host
A new Cursor version that changes the tool API

after_tool_call cannot prove same-turn model blocking

rows.tamperResistance: in-process plugin; a removed plugin means no interception at all

rows.tamperResistance: native PreToolUse hook; the host fails open on a crashing or untrusted hook, so the connector maps ask to an explicit deny and denies its own internal errors

Host-level tamper resistance (for example a patched host binary)

residual.description: Per-host native scenario manifests that drive a real host binary through denied-side-effect, benign-twin, disabled-hook, crash, timeout, offline and restart cases.
residual.requiredInput: A licensed and installed copy of each sold host on a disposable Windows, Linux and macOS machine
